hypotheses.claim: Observed direct dependencies can be reconstructed with useful ranking and operating-point quality.
hypotheses.current_evidence: Short neutral NOUL AP 0.799 on 96 synthetic cases; threshold transfer loses recall. No independent naturalistic gold.
hypotheses.next_measurement: Group-disjoint graph gold; macro AP, micro AP, length strata and frozen-dev-threshold errors.

hypotheses.claim: Correct graph structure helps frozen SAFETY beyond highlighting the same facts.
hypotheses.next_measurement: Verified graph versus full prefix and node-only highlighting on action-labeled prefixes.

hypotheses.claim: Inferred graphs retain enough relevant structure to improve SAFETY in practice.
hypotheses.next_measurement: Only after H2: inferred versus verified graph and matched baseline on a locked cohort.

hypotheses.claim: Graph benefit degrades predictably with false and missing dependencies.
hypotheses.next_measurement: Independent deletion, addition and rewiring interventions on verified graphs.

assumptions_to_validate: Gold labels are identifiable from the model-visible prefix
Direct data use differs from textual overlap
Scenario families, not seeds, define independence
A relevant subgraph can aid this frozen model
Graph benefit is distinct from extra tokens and highlighting
Long-context rejection does not silently change the target population
